think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s purpose and normal numeric domain from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether the knob defines sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the behavior to a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special-case) rather than just “smaller/larger”. 3) If such sentinel values exist, mark it as a special knob and list those values; otherwise mark it non-special.
